title: Oral virome in health and disease
html: Despite estimates suggesting more than 380 trillion viruses reside within the body, an order of magnitude greater than the number of bacteria, the human virome remains largely unexplored. Pandemics and worldwide threats over the past century have highlighted our limited knowledge of viral pathogens in the body. Moreover, knowledge of what constitutes a healthy human virome is lacking, representing a considerable knowledge gap. The National Institutes of Health Human Virome Program aims to fill this gap by means of defining all facets of the human virome across the life and health spans in diverse populations.
